text:
Arjun: Heads-up — I'm applying the TF for the new payments namespace and SA but the IRSA annotation isn't being set by the module, seeing failures in pod startup. Anyone hit this pattern before?
Mia: which module? the accounts module or our k8s infra one?
Arjun: payments-team infra module. It calls kubernetes_service_account and expects us to annotate with `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn`. but the role resource lives in a separate TF workspace (iam/roles).
Sarah: ah yeah cross-workspace outputs can be flaky if you're not passing the role arn into the k8s module. Are you doing a remote state data lookup?
Arjun: currently we were trying `data "terraform_remote_state"` in the k8s workspace, but timing sometimes produces a plan that doesn't include the annotation. plan shows the SA without the annotation then apply adds it — race?
Pete: remote_state is fine usually. Could be the provider ordering — kube provider sees SA created before we set annotation if role arn is empty at plan time. Suggest passing the role arn as an explicit variable into the module so plan has it.
Mia: +1. Also double-check the module uses `metadata { annotations = var.annotations }` not `merge` that could overwrite.
Arjun: Good call. One other wrinkle: the service account needs to be cluster-scoped bound to monitoring read role in the `monitoring` ns via a RoleBinding created in monitoring ns. Should that RoleBinding live in monitoring terraform or payments terraform?
Sarah: Put the RoleBinding in monitoring terraform (owner of monitoring namespace). Create it with subject pointing to `serviceAccount: payments-prod:payments-sa`. That's simpler for ownership.
Pete: When you create cross-namespace RoleBinding, make sure the subject name and namespace are exact. Example snippet we use: ```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: monitoring-read-payments
  namespace: monitoring
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
  kind: Role
  name: monitoring-read
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: payments-sa
  namespace: payments-prod
```
Mia: Also check node of IRSA vs projected service account tokens. With IRSA you still get projected tokens but pods assume the IAM role via OIDC provider. Ensure your cluster has the OIDC provider created and the IAM role trust policy includes `StringEquals` on `sts:aud` if you're using projected tokens.
Arjun: We're on EKS, OIDC provider exists. Role trust is `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity`. My concern was the annotation not being present until after SA creation so pods that mount token fail to assume role.
Sarah: Two options: 1) make the SA annotation part of the initial `kubernetes_service_account` resource (pass role arn var) so it's present at create time; 2) if that's hard, add a pre-deployment hook that waits for the annotated SA to exist before deploying pods. We've used an init job that retries `kubectl get sa -n payments-prod payments-sa -o yaml` and checks for annotation.
Pete: Another tip — if the role is created in another workspace, export its arn as a SSM parameter during IAM apply, then read SSM in the k8s workspace. Avoids terraform_remote_state ordering issues.
Arjun: Nice. Which approach should I adopt for the rollout today? I can update the module to accept `assume_role_arn` var and wire it from remote state, or use SSM temp fix.
Mia: For speed, SSM param works and is lower churn. Long term patch the module to require the role arn variable. Put a validator doc entry in infra docs so future namespaces follow this pattern.
Arjun: Ok I'll do SSM temp fix + follow-up PR to module. Will also add the RoleBinding PR to monitoring repo and ping ops for review.
infra-bot: plan finished: 2 to add, 1 to change (service account annotation), no deletes. See: https://ci.internal/plan/1769401234
Sarah: after the PR, remember to add an integration test that creates a pod with `curl https://sts.amazonaws.com` call to assert the token works (or just check `aws sts get-caller-identity`). We have a small test job in infra-tests that can be re-used.
Arjun: will file the follow-up ticket and link the test. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Pete: ping me once SSM param is live, I can kick off the monitoring RoleBinding apply.
Mia: leaving a note in #eng-docs about the pattern: "k8s SA IRSA — require role ARN as module var"
Arjun: done. PRs incoming.
